decisions.reason: As a formwork profile system closely tied to the firm's core modular factory solutions and shown prominently after launch, it fits existing knowledge and can be improved and sold through the firm's established engineering and service capabilities.

The shuttering magnet block is highly related to the firm's formwork and prefabrication know-how, so even if it is a smaller line item, the firm can absorb user feedback easily and keep it as a complementary component in its system offering.

Because this magnetic formwork component builds directly on the firm's established technology base and was given dedicated market visibility, management is likely to retain it and refine it through in-house R&D rather than withdraw it.

Although this magnetic formwork component appears less central than products with their own pages, it is still close enough to the firm's existing knowledge and installed customer base that keeping it is more likely than dropping it.
